Name: GMCM Quick Search - Search Mod Configs Instantly
Author: ZeroXPatch
Description:
[b][color=#ffff00][size=6][center]GMCM Quick Search[/center][/size][/color]
[color=#00ff00][center][size=3]Safe to uninstall anytime. Removing it just disables the features.

[/size][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/ZeroXPatch/mods?gameId=1303&sortBy=endorsements]https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/ZeroXPatch/mods?gameId=1303&sortBy=endorsements
[/url][/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/ZeroXPatch/mods?gameId=1303&sortBy=downloads][/url][/center][/color][/b]
[center]If your GMCM list has gotten out of control, this is for you.

[b]GMCM Quick Search[/b] adds a clean search window you can open anytime with [b]F6[/b].

Start typing to filter your GMCM-enabled mods by [b]mod name or author name[/b],

then click (or press Enter) to open that mod’s config instantly.

This doesn’t replace GMCM — it just gets you to the right config [b]fast[/b].[/center][center]

[youtube]I5KaksjBQrs[/youtube][/center]

[b][color=#00ffff]Features[/color][/b]

[list]
[*][b]Press F6 to open[/b] the search window.
[*][b]Type to filter[/b] mods by [b]name or author[/b] (e.g. “Pathoschild”, “spacechase0”, etc).
[*][b]Click a result[/b] (or press Enter) to open that mod’s config in [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b].
[*]Optional: show the mod’s [b]UniqueID[/b] under its name (useful when mods have similar names).
[/list]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/40282/40282-1765961751-569787033.png[/img]﻿[/center][b][color=#00ffff]How to use[/color][/b][list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI + GMCM.

[*]Install this mod.

[*]Launch the game.

[*]Press [b]F6[/b] to open [b]GMCM Quick Search[/b].

[*]Type a mod name [b]or author name[/b] → click the result (or press Enter) → configure.
[/list]
